basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old gamer and hobbyist from Houston, Texas. I spend my free time diving into tactical shooters like Escape from Tarkov and occasionally indulge in the nostalgia of shows like Julie and the Phantoms. I'm currently working as an IT support specialist at a local university, which keeps me tethered to my computer for most of the day. In the evenings, I unwind by exploring niche internet communities, ranging from gaming to niche lifestyle interests. Despite my digital life, I try to keep fit and manage a mild case of scoliosis with regular exercises. I'm single and usually online during late nights and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in IT with a degree in Computer Science from the University of Houston. My gaming knowledge, particularly in tactical shooters, comes from years of playing and engaging with online communities. I'm also self-taught in various lifestyle topics, thanks to the diverse subreddits I follow.
